description: Future Fire Weather Projections CanLEAD-FWI Version 1.0 is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Canadian wildfire activity is changing in part because human-caused climate change is causing more hot and dry weather conditions conducive to wildfires, also referred to as “fire weather” (Kirchmeier-Young et al., 2019). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
